# Faculty Case Worksheet

Use this worksheet to turn a source PDF or Word case into a structured pilot case. Keep patient-known information separate from chart-only data and faculty-only teaching material.

## Case Identity

- Case title:
- Course/session:
- Setting:
- Patient display name:
- Age and pronouns:
- Chief concern:
- One-sentence tile description:
- Source file name/path:

## Patient Persona And Behavior

- Human background:
- Speaking style:
- Emotional tone:
- Opening statement: keep this high-level for broad "what brought you in" questions; do not list the symptom cluster.
- Disclosure style: broad openers should not reveal symptoms, diagnosis, objective data, timeline, family consequences, or sensitive history until the learner asks.
- Sensitive-topic style:
- Physical-exam consent style:
- Uncertainty style for chart-only data:

## Patient-Known Facts

- History of present illness:
- Relevant positives:
- Relevant negatives:
- Past medical/surgical history:
- Medications:
- Allergies:
- Family history:
- Social history:
- Sensitive history, if relevant:
- Anticipated student questions and patient-voice answers:
- Semantic-equivalent answer groups:
  - Group ID:
  - Canonical question:
  - Likely student paraphrases/aliases:
  - Patient answer facts that must stay the same:
  - Required response terms for validation:
  - Forbidden/invented response terms:

## Objective Artifacts

List anything the patient should not narrate as if they know the clinician result.

- Labs/toxicology:
- Vital signs:
- Physical exam findings:
- Mental status exam:
- ECG/imaging/procedure results:
- Other chart-only notes:
- Suggested learner trigger terms:

## Faculty-Only Hidden Material

- Diagnosis:
- Teaching points:
- Forbidden response terms:
- Validation prompts that should stay in patient interview mode:
- Validation prompts that should redirect to the results panel:

## Signoff

- Patient answers common H&P questions accurately:
- Sensitive topics are clinically appropriate:
- Objective data stays outside patient dialogue:
- Hidden diagnosis and teaching points are not leaked:
- Case owner:
- Review date:
